cases.name: Scarlett Marie Marsh
cases.about: Scarlett’s mother Isabelle described Scarlett as a beautiful, happy and joyful baby. Her obituary said, "Scarlett was an active member of First Baptist Church in Midland attending her first church service at just two days old. Scarlett had an infectious smile and was a very happy baby. She loved music and dancing. She loved watching the movie Encanto with its bright colors and music. Isabelle has requested, if possible, that people wear bright colors to Scarlett's funeral because her favorite blanket was orange and she loved bright colors. Although, all who loved Scarlett are deeply grieving we are comforted knowing that Scarlett is being rocked and sung to by her great-great grandmother Thora March."
cases.narrative: While her mother was at work and he watched his daughter, he "admitted Scarlett was crying and that he threw a large gray blanket (adult sized/ heavy blanket ) over top of Scarlett in her crib” and over Scarlett’s “entire body.” It was a weighted blanket which weighed 4 pounds. Cops concluded, and prosecutors alleged, that Alex Marsh was playing video games when Scarlett died of asphyxiation in her crib. Then he went to pick his wife up from work in the morning, already knowing the child was dead, according to police. The couple returned home and that’s when the mother found the deceased infant.
